---
title: "Ion mass calculator"
toc: false
---

Calculate ion properties from a chemical formula and charge, running entirely in your browser via WebAssembly ([MassSpecToolkit](https://github.com/H3Jones/MassSpecToolkit)).

```{=html}
<script type="module" src="ms-toolkit/ion-calculator.mjs"></script>
<ms-ion-calculator formula="C6H12O6" charge="1"></ms-ion-calculator>
```
